chapterTitle: Federal Board Annual Exam Simulator 06 (Guess Paper 6)
subject: math-10

questions.question: The difference between upper limits of two consecutive classes in a frequency table is:
questions.explanation: The difference between corresponding limits of adjacent classes is the class interval (h).

questions.question: A cumulative frequency curve is also called a/an:
questions.explanation: A graphical representation of cumulative frequencies is termed an ogive.

questions.question: The number of times a value appears in a set of data is called its:
questions.explanation: The count of occurrences of a score is its frequency.

A circle passing through all three vertices of a triangle is called:
questions.explanation: The circle through the vertices of a triangle is its circumcircle.

questions.question: The centre of a circumcircle is the point of concurrency of the:
questions.explanation: The perpendicular bisectors of the sides meet at the circumcentre.

questions.question: A circle which touches all three sides of a triangle internally is called:
questions.explanation: An incircle touches all three sides internally.

questions.question: The centre of an inscribed circle is the point of concurrency of the:
questions.explanation: Internal angle bisectors intersect at the incentre.

questions.question: How many escribed circles can be drawn for a triangle?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 excircles, one opposite each vertex.

questions.question: The circumcentre of a right-angled triangle lies:
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse forms the diameter of the circumcircle, so its midpoint is the circumcentre.

questions.question: How many tangents can be drawn to a circle from an external point?
questions.explanation: Exactly two tangents can be drawn from an exterior point to a circle.
